//: Strict config for the rewrite tree under src/. Node 24 runs the .ts sources directly via type-stripping, so this config exists to ENFORCE the type-safety gate (tsc --noEmit), not to build.
//incremental: The gate runs on every turn, so re-elaborating an unchanged src/ every time is the largest avoidable cost in the inner loop. The buildinfo lives under node_modules/.cache because it is a derived artifact whose loss costs only one cold run — and node_modules/ is already ignored, so no ignore rule can drift away from it. Every config that extends this one MUST name its own tsBuildInfoFile: an inherited relative path resolves against THIS directory, so two projects would otherwise share one buildinfo and each would invalidate the other's.
